Getting the HR call on your couch with a newborn: the brutal legal reality of maternity leave layoffs.
Evidence: FMLA loopholes, 845k women left workforce, Restructuring pretexts
#Aletheia #Labor

Exposing corporate legal loopholes that allow employers to terminate women while on maternity leave.

Legal restructuring provisions routinely enable companies to mask discriminatory terminations of new mothers.

CNBC reported on Baltimore media professional Jess Mayhugh and thousands of women facing layoffs while on postpartum leave due to legal carve-outs in US labor acts.

Shining a bright investigative light on hidden legal loopholes forces public scrutiny and advocacy for stronger worker protections.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:

Corporations run a smart selfish maneuver, using neutral economic restructuring as a pretext to shed vulnerable workers while projecting blame onto macroeconomic conditions.

The Unavoidable Truth: Legal loopholes allow companies to fire women on maternity leave.

The Unavoidable Lie: Employment laws adequately protect working mothers from structural discrimination.
